prompt:
Create ONE original Soulmonsters ADULT KNIGHT evolution above the attached OWN selected reptile creature. Use this own reference for ancestry: small angular indigo/ivory wedge head, narrow amber eye slits, coral muzzle, golden side knot, continuous curved paper planes and two chevron soul-tail tabs. Transform the creature into a mature towering armored knight with a SMALL head relative to shoulders. Keep the 2D manga authorial style. Single fullbody threequarter hero on WHITE, all cape, sword, feet and tail tips framed with generous margins, no text or extra poses.
STRUCTURE requested: monumental compact heroic knight, broad raised shoulder architecture, thick layered forearms, deep torso, narrow flexible waist, powerful armored legs and grounded heavy sabatons. About seven to seven-and-a-half heads tall. Exactly two arms/two legs. Broad rounded-arch pauldrons with GOLD curved structural rims, one slightly higher and wider than the other. Smooth large indigo-black armor plates with warm IVORY folded leading sections and a few restrained CORAL inlays at side waist and knees; gold only structural rim edges, not filigree everywhere. Armor is hardened laminated living kite-paper and curved bamboo splines, with a few broad creases only, not crumpled origami, shiny metal suit, tiny repetitive scales or spikes. Plum flexible joint gaps reveal articulated elbow, shoulder, hip and knee design.
HELM: reinterpret the selected OWN wedge face into closed adult cranial armor retaining ivory overlapping brow bridge and two indigo swept cheek planes, two tiny narrow AMBER eye slits, coral lower cheek accents. Entire mouth closed by a short ivory angular jaw guard, no human face, no childish muzzle. A small GOLD knotted temple root repeats ancestry, no random horns or crest borrowed from another character. Small head, strong neck collar and broad silhouette.
MANDATORY focal detail: ONE prominent translucent AMBER CRYSTAL in the EXACT SHAPE OF A BRAZILIAN KITE high on upper sternum just beneath collar, an elongated asymmetrical diamond with a longer bottom tip and shorter upper triangle, two fine diagonal cross-spar lines visible inside the gem. It is a true faceted crystal inset in an ivory/gold socket, not a painted logo, flat card, cross, round gem or glowing orb. Clear readable gap around chest gem, restrained single highlight, no bloom hiding silhouette.
MANDATORY CAPE: a large DEEP INDIGO outer cape with warm IVORY inner lining, rooted clearly behind shoulders. It sweeps to viewer LEFT in three big heavy sections, visibly DESTROYED/TATTERED along lower and trailing edges with missing triangular areas and a few broad holes, asymmetrical wear, no blood. Broad quiet surfaces, no countless tiny shredded strands, no separate flight wings. Keep both arms and legs distinguishable in front of cape.
MANDATORY SWORD: ONE long broad straight IVORY-and-dark-indigo sword with a gold structural spine, simple double-sided blade and two small kite-spar guard arms meeting at a GOLD KNOT hilt. Right/near gauntlet clearly grips handle, sword held diagonally DOWN to viewer RIGHT away from feet, blade tip fully visible. Sword is visibly separate from forearm, no second weapon or shield. Left free hand relaxed half-closed at side. Clear solemn experienced guard pose with one foot forward and braced rear leg, upper torso slightly turned, proud quiet presence instead of attack effects.
One complete independent soul-rabiola from rear waist, gold cord with TWO ivory/indigo chevron tabs visible on side away from sword, not tangled into cape. Tail can be reduced to articulated short base because adult anatomy changes; keep spirit continuity. Strong creature head inheritance within knight architecture, not an ordinary human in cosplay. 45% creature identity,45% functional living kite structure,10% clean manga/selective stepped contour. Crisp confident dark lines, flat saturated indigo/ivory/coral/gold, ONE hard cel shadow, no realistic rendering, gradients, heavy texture, metallic glare, tiny triangles or ornate noise. Do not copy a named franchise helmet, chest emblem, sword, costume panel arrangement or abilities. Only own reference image is supplied.
review: Primeiro cavaleiro adulto: cristal em pipa alto no peito, capa rasgada, espada e armadura robusta. Autor pediu refazer o helmet com shape de dragão superior e viseira inferior fechada; esta versão fica como histórico do pedido.

prompt:
Edit this OWN original Soulmonsters adult knight concept. Change ONLY the HEAD/HELMET architecture, preserving the small head-to-shoulder proportion and all other design details.
The current head still looks like a creature's exposed short face. Replace it with a true closed DRAGON-SHAPED KNIGHT HELMET.
UPPER HELMET: a compact sculpted DRAGON cranium with a clearly projecting short armored snout above the eye slit, angular nasal ridge, ivory forehead keel continuing backward and TWO swept indigo/ivory horn-like cranial fins rooted at temples. These are armor structure interpreting the previous creature, not a living animal head sitting on top of another helmet. The front upper brow should suggest a dragon's upper jaw overhanging the visor. A few broad decisive ivory and indigo plates with thin gold seams, same family geometry, no pile of tiny spikes or copied franchise helmet. Keep narrow AMBER optical slits in the deep shadow beneath the dragon brow.
LOWER HELMET: a FULLY CLOSED solid angular dark-indigo face VISOR from nose level to pointed ivory chin guard. Completely cover the former coral muzzle and exposed mouth. NO visible flesh, lips, nostrils, teeth, biological lower snout or open mouth. A single central ridge and two short restrained diagonal ventilation seams may define the closed visor; it is a protected knight faceplate, not a human face or mask with mouth drawn on it. Helmet side cheek pieces lock into short neck collar. Upper dragon shape and lower sealed visor must read as ONE coherent wearable cranial armor system. Small head, no enlargement into mascot proportions.
Preserve unchanged in design: massive indigo/ivory/gold shoulder armor, AMBER KITE-SHAPED CRYSTAL high on chest, coral accent panels, articulated gauntlets and legs, sword and exact grip, battered indigo cape with ivory lining and tears, two chevron soul-tail tabs, fullbody pose and white background. Do not redesign body, add weapons or alter colors. Same clean 2D manga flat cel drawing with crisp dark lines and few large planes, no realistic textures or extra text. All figure/cape/sword tips in frame.
review: Elmo superior com focinho projetado, testa e duas cristas dracônicas; visor inferior índigo fechado, sem lábio ou focinho coral exposto. Olhos aparecem por fendas. Cristal alto em formato de pipa, espada e capa rasgada presentes. Duas mãos, duas pernas, duas abas da rabiola; raiz do fio fica parcialmente ocluída pela mão/guarda. A edição manteve os elementos principais do corpo, mas não garante igualdade pixel a pixel. Pontas do elmo têm margem pequena; conferir recorte ao preparar asset. Articulações e capa precisam de costas/perfil antes de rig.
